engagement_participants_reason_check.name: engagement_participants_reason_check
engagement_participants_reason_check.value: ("removed_at" is null and "removal_reason" is null) or ("removed_at" is not null and "removal_reason" in ('REMOVED', 'ENGAGEMENT_CLOSED'))

engagements_event_team_open_uq.name: engagements_event_team_open_uq
engagements_event_team_open_uq.where: "team_id" is not null and "status" not in ('WITHDRAWN', 'NOT_SELECTED')

engagements_team_kind_check.name: engagements_team_kind_check
engagements_team_kind_check.value: ("participant_kind" = 'TEAM' and "team_id" is not null) or ("participant_kind" = 'INDIVIDUAL' and "team_id" is null)

event_changes_value_check.name: event_changes_value_check
event_changes_value_check.value: "old_value_json" is not null or "new_value_json" is not null

events_fee_known_check.name: events_fee_known_check
events_fee_known_check.value: ("fee_known" = 0 and "fee_minor" is null) or ("fee_known" = 1 and "fee_minor" is not null and "fee_currency" is not null)

events_prize_currency_check.name: events_prize_currency_check
events_prize_currency_check.value: "prize_total_minor" is null or "prize_currency" is not null

events_team_max_check.name: events_team_max_check
events_team_max_check.value: "team_max" is null or ("team_max" >= 1 and ("team_min" is null or "team_max" >= "team_min"))

events_country_code_check.name: events_country_code_check
events_country_code_check.value: "country_code" is null or ("country_code" = upper("country_code") and length("country_code") = 2)

events_date_order_check.name: events_date_order_check
events_date_order_check.value: "starts_at" is null or "ends_at" is null or "ends_at" >= "starts_at"

institutions_country_code_check.name: institutions_country_code_check
institutions_country_code_check.value: "country_code" is null or ("country_code" = upper("country_code") and length("country_code") = 2)
